answer_1.quote: We introduce a new task of party-specific extractive summarization of important obligations, entitlements, and prohibitions in legal contracts.
answer_1.outputs: Extractive summaries consisting of the most important sentences (obligations, entitlements, prohibitions) for a specified party

answer_2.quote: We report Precision@k, Recall@k, F1@k, MAP, NDCG and ROUGE-1/2/L scores for the end-to-end summarization task.

answer_4.quote: In addition to automatic evaluation, we also give contracts along with their party-specific summaries from CONTRASUM ... to legal experts for human evaluation. They are asked to rate the summaries for each category on a 5-point scale ... and the overall quality on a 10-point scale.
answer_4.guideline: Legal experts rate each summary on informativeness, usefulness, accuracy of categorization, redundancy, accuracy of importance ranking, and overall quality.
